mapper.select: SELECT rv.id, rv.user_id, rv.resource_id, rv.reserve_date, rv.start_time, rv.end_time, rv.status, rv.checkin_time, rv.finish_time, rv.cancel_reason, rv.remark, rv.create_time, rv.update_time, r.name AS resource_name FROM `reservation` rv LEFT JOIN `resource` r ON rv.resource_id = r.id WHERE rv.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `reservation` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'IN_USE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `reservation` (user_id, resource_id, reserve_date, start_time, end_time, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{resourceId}, #{reserveDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, resource_id, start_time, end_time FROM `reservation` WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND start_time < #{deadline}
SELECT id, resource_id, start_time, end_time FROM `reservation` WHERE status = 'IN_USE' AND end_time < #{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE `reservation` SET status = 'EXPIRED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
UPDATE `reservation` SET status = 'COMPLETED', finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'IN_USE'
